data: In fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, NVIDIA reported GAAP revenue of about $130.5 billion, up 114% from $60.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Cost of revenue was roughly $32.6 billion, so gross profit came to about $97.9 billion and GAAP gross margin was 75.0%, compared with 72.7% in fiscal 2024. Operating expenses were about $16.4 billion, which left GAAP operating income of roughly $81.5 billion and an operating margin of about 62.4%, up from 54.1% the year before. On a non-GAAP basis, gross margin was about 75.5%. These figures come from NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 annual report, and you should check them against the 10-K if exact numbers are needed.
